message: fix(merchant): replace auto-coerced quantities with explicit integer entry
purpose: The rendered regression still rejects the pending quantity before snapshot refresh. SpinBox owns an expression parser and rewrites text on editing-state changes. Replace only the merchant quantity field with a native LineEdit and explicit minus/plus controls. Never coerce invalid text on focus loss or snapshot updates. Preserve all quantity, caret, color, gold, replay, receipt and layout assertions; adapt their control type and add below-limit and focus-loss checks. Retain the real-server merchant test and all previous gameplay tests.

replacements.old:
amount = new SpinBox { Name = "SaleQuantity", MinValue = 1, MaxValue = 999, Step = 1, Value = 1, CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(132, 32) };
        amount.GetLineEdit().Alignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center; amountRow.AddChild(amount);

replacements.new:
// Snapshot updates change validation, never the pending text or caret.
                amount.PlaceholderText = "1–" + current.Quantity;

replacements.old: check(Find<Button>("SellSelectedQuantity").Disabled&&requests==1,"Invalid text cannot become a silent sale quantity");
